description: A request head (request line plus header block) over 64 KiB is answered 431 {"error":"request head too large"} before the path is looked at. The edge writes the head; the cap applies to what arrives on the stream. MCPWARP.md §4 limits
in:
POST /mcp HTTP/1.1
Host: notes-tester.mcpwarp.test
x-padding: <PAD>
Content-Length: 0
out:
HTTP/1.1 431 Request Header Fields Too Large
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 34

{"error":"request head too large"}
notes: `inExpand` keeps the fixture readable: replace the marker with 65536 copies of "a" before writing `in`. The SDK MAY answer as soon as 65536 head bytes arrived without a blank line. A head that does not complete within 10000 ms is RESET with CANCEL instead (no response).
